title: agent harnesses / Requirements and setup
content: ## Requirements and setup Check the accounts, extensions, and settings needed for your chosen harness or the Cloud target. If a choice does not appear in the **Session Target** UI control, start with its requirements below. Your harness and model access are separate choices. Using a provider's model through {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} is different from using that provider's own credentials. The access option you select determines which account's usage limits and billing apply. If you're starting with an existing account or key: * **{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} access**: Start with the [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness](#copilot). The [{% data variables.product.prodname_anthropic_claude %}](#claude) and [{% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %}](#codex) integrations also offer Copilot-routed models, subject to their requirements. * **{% data variables.product.prodname_anthropic_claude %} credentials**: Follow the [authentication options](#claude). * **ChatGPT account**: Follow the [Codex setup](#codex) for your chosen integration. * **Another model API key or local model**: [Configure a model provider](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#bring-your-own-language-model-key) for Local sessions or supported Experimental Copilot harness workflows. For access through a provider's own credentials, that provider's usage limits, billing, and data-handling terms apply. Organization policies can restrict the available routes, even when you have separate credentials. {% tabs id="harness-setup" %} {% tab label="Copilot" %} ### Copilot To use models through {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %}, follow the [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} setup guide](/docs/setup/copilot.md). Copilot harness sessions use the same GitHub authentication context as chat in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, including your GitHub Enterprise account when configured. To use supported models through your own credentials, follow the [Experimental Agent Host BYOK setup](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#bring-your-own-language-model-key). This is separate from configuring provider-native authentication for the {% data variables.product.prodname_anthropic_claude %} or {% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %} harness. For managed user accounts on GHE.com, complete the setup in [Using GitHub Copilot with an account on GHE.com](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/managing-copilot/configure-personal-settings/using-github-copilot-with-an-account-on-ghecom). Before reusing a Local harness session's configuration, check [tool availability](/docs/agents/run/tools.md#manage-tool-availability-for-the-copilot-harness) and [MCP configuration compatibility](/docs/agents/reference/mcp-configuration.md#configuration-file). Copilot harness sessions don't have access to every built-in or extension-provided tool. The shared SDK runtime also does not imply identical tools, models, permissions, or customizations across products, or that all sessions and personal settings synchronize. For enterprise SDK Policy Hooks requirements, see [enterprise hook configuration](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#enable-or-disable-hooks). To let a local {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} session interact with desktop applications on macOS or Windows, see [Computer Use (Experimental)](/docs/agents/run/tools.md#control-desktop-applications-experimental). {% /tab %} {% tab label="Claude" %} ### Claude Claude support is enabled by default unless [enterprise-managed settings disable the harness](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability). When organization policy permits it, turn support on or off with `setting(chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled)` (Experimental). To use Claude, configure one of these authentication and billing options: * **GitHub Copilot subscription**: sign in to GitHub to use Copilot-routed models. Usage is billed through your Copilot subscription. * **Bring your own key (BYOK)**: use a Claude API key or another supported Claude BYOK option. Usage is billed by your configured provider. When both options are available, the model picker groups models by **Anthropic** and **Copilot**. The model you select determines the provider and billing method for the next turn. You can switch between BYOK-backed and Copilot-routed models in an existing Claude harness session. To use Claude without signing in to GitHub _(Experimental)_, configure a Claude API key or another supported Claude BYOK option. For an Anthropic API key, set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in your environment or in the `env` object in `~/.claude/settings.json`. Learn more about [Claude Code authentication](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication). Enable `setting(chat.agentHost.allowSignedOutWhenUsable)` to open the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} while signed out of GitHub. The model picker only shows models from your Claude BYOK configuration until you sign in. After you sign in to GitHub, Copilot-routed models are also available. See [Claude permission modes](/docs/agents/run/approvals.md#claude-permission-modes) for approval behavior and related cautions. {% /tab %} {% tab label="Codex" %} ### Codex Codex is not listed by default. Choose one of the following integrations. You don't need both. #### Extension-based integration To use Codex in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}, install and enable the [OpenAI Codex extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=openai.chatgpt). Follow the extension's documentation for authentication and permissions. #### Agent Host integration (Experimental) > [!NOTE] > The Codex Agent Host integration is disabled when [enterprise-managed settings apply](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability), even with a ChatGPT account or the integration's user setting set to `true`. Contact the IT team that deployed the settings to discuss access. Enable `setting(chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled)` to make Codex available in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} without the {% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %} extension. To also use this integration in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}, enable `setting(chat.editor.codex.preferAgentHost)` and restart {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} when prompted. Only one Codex implementation appears in each window. In the **Session Target** UI control, this setting replaces the **Codex** choice contributed by the OpenAI extension. Choose one of these access options for the Agent Host integration: * **GitHub Copilot subscription**: sign in to GitHub to use Copilot-backed models. This option requires {% data variables.copilot.copilot_pro_plus_short %}. * **ChatGPT account**: open the account menu and select **Sign in to ChatGPT**. A free ChatGPT account is sufficient. When both accounts are signed in, the model picker groups models by **Copilot** and **ChatGPT**. Your selection determines which account provides model access, and {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} saves that provider with the session. To use Codex without signing in to GitHub _(Experimental)_, sign in to ChatGPT and enable `setting(chat.agentHost.allowSignedOutWhenUsable)`. The {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} then shows ChatGPT-backed models while signed out. Copilot-backed models prompt you to sign in to GitHub, and the browser-based {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} still requires GitHub sign-in. See [Codex approval presets](/docs/agents/run/approvals.md#codex-approval-presets) for approval behavior and related cautions. {% /tab %} {% tab label="Local" %} ### Local Local harness sessions use the models configured in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. [Set up {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %}](/docs/setup/copilot.md) to use Copilot-provided models, or [configure your own model credentials](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#bring-your-own-language-model-key) for a supported model. Select **Local** in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} and keep the editor window open while the agent works. Local harness sessions use different [customization settings](/docs/agent-customization/custom-instructions.md) from Copilot harness sessions. SDK Policy Hooks are not loaded in Local harness sessions. Check [hook compatibility](/docs/agent-customization/hooks.md#migrate-hooks-between-harnesses) before reusing hooks from another harness. {% /tab %} {% /tabs %} ### Cloud target Use a cloud session to work interactively with an agent on managed compute and return to the same session later, without keeping your own machine online. Cloud is an execution target, separate from your choice of language model. #### Cloud sessions `feature(cloud-sessions)` With `setting(chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.enabled)` on, new **Cloud** sessions use a managed environment running the {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} runtime. In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, this replaces the {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cloud_agent %} workflow on {% data variables.product.prodname_github %} Actions for new **Cloud** sessions. You can send follow-ups and reconnect to the session without keeping your own machine online. Connections require `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled)` and service access for your account. The cloud environment has its own workspace and tools. Choosing another model doesn't change the harness. Enabling cloud sessions doesn't move a local conversation or local files into the cloud. To get started, follow [Run cloud sessions](/docs/agents/run/cloud-sandbox-sessions.md) for creation, continuation, and lifecycle guidance. The **Cloud** creation experience depends on your settings and account availability.
